verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Sentry's general API (sentry-docs-14, sentry-docs-20) and MCP integration for AI assistants (sentry-docs-1, sentry-docs-2, sentry-docs-19), plus SAML/SCIM for enterprise SSO (sentry-docs-28), but nowhere mentions scoped or least-privilege API tokens/credentials specifically issuable for an agent.
